dish: mì vịt tiềm (braised duck & egg-noodle soup)
address: 59C Thuận Kiều, Ward 12, District 5 (Cholon), Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: Cholon's beloved Cantonese duck-noodle house — cinnamon-scented broth, lightly seasoned juicy braised duck, house-made egg noodles. A Saigoneer Hẻm Gems feature.

dish: hủ tiếu sa tế (Teochew satay noodle soup)
n: Hủ Tiếu Sa Tế Quảng Ký
address: 117 Triệu Quang Phục, Ward 11, District 5 (Cholon), Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: Teochew satay-noodle specialist in Cholon — a spicy-savoury broth built from 30+ condiments, a signature Chợ Lớn dish brought by 19th-century Teochew migrants.

dish: dim sum (har gow, char siu bao, chicken wing stuffed with glutinous rice)
address: District 5 (Cholon), Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: Cantonese dim-sum house awarded the MICHELIN Bib Gourmand (2023 & 2024); known for dishes found nowhere else in Saigon's Chinatown.

dish: chè (chè hột gà trà, chè hạnh nhân and other Cantonese sweet soups)
address: District 5 (Cholon), Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A 30-year Cholon institution that grew from a single chè stall into a symbol of Chinese-Vietnamese sweets — egg-in-tea chè and almond chè among the classics.

dish: ốc (assorted snails) & salt-roasted crab claws
address: 534 Vĩnh Khánh, District 4, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: The most famous ốc house on District 4's Vĩnh Khánh seafood strip (~20 years); a MICHELIN Bib Gourmand 2024 pick, signature salt-roasted crab claws, plastic-stool buzz.

dish: ốc (snails), grilled scallops & sò huyết (blood cockles)
address: Vĩnh Khánh, District 4, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A long-loved Saigon ốc name known for fresh, well-seasoned snails and grilled shellfish; a fixture of the District 4 Vĩnh Khánh seafood-street scene.

dish: bún bò Huế (Hue-style beef & tendon noodle soup)
address: Bình Thạnh District, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: One of Bình Thạnh's best-known bún bò Huế houses, styled like a countryside home — a beloved local institution in one of Saigon's most underrated street-food districts.

dish: elevated Vietnamese street food (Đông Hồ caviar, luxe phở, foie-gras bánh mì)
address: 89 Tôn Thất Đạm, Bến Nghé Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: Chef Peter Cường Franklin's tube-house restaurant that turns Saigon street food into fine dining — Ho Chi Minh City's first and enduring 1-MICHELIN-Star (2023-2025).

dish: modern Vietnamese (clay-pot & charcoal-grilled dishes)
address: 35 Xuân Thủy, Thảo Điền, District 2 (Thủ Đức City), Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A reinvented modern-Vietnamese space in Thảo Điền; a MICHELIN Selected restaurant (2023) spotlighted in Saigon's 'new Vietnamese' wave.

dish: modern Vietnamese & Asian-inspired dishes (cá kho tộ, garden dining)
address: 22 Đặng Hữu Phổ, Thảo Điền, District 2 (Thủ Đức City), Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A tranquil green villa in Thảo Điền serving authentic Vietnamese with a gentle modern twist and vegetarian focus — a District 2 expat favourite.

dish: all-day brunch (big breakfast, house-baked goods)
address: Thảo Điền, District 2 (Thủ Đức City), Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A health-leaning all-day brunch villa in a spacious Thảo Điền garden — a mainstay of District 2's expat brunch scene.

dish: concept-store brunch & pastries (local-ingredient dishes)
address: Thảo Điền, District 2, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam (also Lê Lợi & Đồng Khởi, District 1)
w: A pioneering concept-store cafe-bistro brand that keeps innovating brunch with Vietnamese ingredients; the Thảo Điền outlet anchors District 2.

dish: single-origin pour-over & espresso (no condensed milk)
address: 3rd floor, 27 Ngô Đức Kế, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: Saigon's first specialty roaster (2014) and unofficial HQ of Vietnamese specialty coffee — transparency-first, long shared tables, pour-over and cold brew.

dish: Vietnamese single-origin specialty coffee & filter flights
address: 6E Tú Xương, Võ Thị Sáu Ward, District 3, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam (flagship roastery in Thảo Điền, District 2)
w: Called 'the specialty coffee of the moment' — a sustainability-minded Vietnamese roaster championing single origins from Buôn Ma Thuột and beyond.

dish: specialty & egg coffee, siphon/theatrical brews
address: 27 Lưu Văn Lang, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: Widely regarded as one of the city's best practitioners of specialty coffee — serious brew hardware, Vietnamese and international beans, standout egg coffee.

dish: Dalat farm-to-cup single-origin coffee
address: 193 Hai Bà Trưng, District 3, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A true farm-to-cup Vietnamese roaster growing its beans in Dalat's Central Highlands — one of the country's defining specialty brands.

dish: cà phê vợt (cloth-sock filter coffee) & cà phê sữa đá
address: 109/36 Nguyễn Thiện Thuật, District 3, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: Opened 1938 — Saigon's oldest cafe and last cà phê vợt (cloth-sock filter) shop, coffee still brewed in batches over charcoal the pre-phin way. A family heirloom.

dish: cà phê cốt dừa (coconut-coffee smoothie)
address: 26 Lý Tự Trọng & Nguyễn Huệ, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam (multiple branches)
w: The retro, olive-green subsidy-era chain that made cà phê cốt dừa (coconut coffee) a Saigon signature — a near-obligatory coconut-coffee stop.

dish: small-batch roasted cà phê sữa đá & specialty coffee
address: 22 Lê Lợi, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam (branches incl. Thảo Điền, District 2)
w: A sleek retro-Saigon small-batch roaster near Bến Thành that blends traditional Vietnamese coffee with modern specialty craft across its city outlets.

dish: Arabica single-origin specialty coffee in a riverside mansion
address: Saigon Pearl, Nguyễn Hữu Cảnh, Bình Thạnh District, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A multi-storey riverside coffee mansion (opened 2016) that helped awaken Vietnam's Arabica specialty scene and trained national barista champions.

dish: modern-classic cocktails (jazz speakeasy)
address: 1st floor, 136 Lê Thánh Tôn, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: Saigon's highest-placed bar on Asia's 50 Best Bars (ranked 2022-2025, No. 61 in 2025) — a speakeasy-jazz room of precise modern-classic drinks.

dish: craft cocktails in a colonial apartment block
address: 2nd floor, 63 Đồng Du, Bến Nghé Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: An artful cocktail bar in an old colonial apartment — bar director Jay Moir's spirited, botanical-and-spice list; featured on World's 50 Best Discovery.

dish: seasonal sustainable cocktails (locally-grown botanicals)
address: District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: Layla's experimental sibling and a sustainability-driven cocktail lab — Saigon's sole entrant on Asia's 50 Best Bars 51-100 in 2021 (No. 77).

dish: hidden speakeasy craft cocktails
address: 2nd floor, 25 Hồ Tùng Mậu, Nguyễn Thái Bình Ward, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A reliably lively hidden speakeasy that made Asia's 50 Best Bars (51-100, 2024) — one of Saigon's defining craft-cocktail rooms.

dish: Vietnamese-ingredient cocktails in a century-old colonial mansion
address: Tôn Đức Thắng, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A renovated century-old colonial mansion pairing local Vietnamese ingredients with modern technique — Asia's 50 Best Bars No. 93 (2025) and Tatler's Vietnam Bar of the Year 2025.

dish: 1920s New York-themed speakeasy classic cocktails
address: 1st floor, 14 Tôn Thất Đạm, District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A 1920s New York-styled speakeasy specialising in classic cocktails and mixology — one of the bars that seeded Saigon's speakeasy wave.

dish: craft cocktails
address: District 1, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A Saigon craft-cocktail bar recognised on Asia's 50 Best Bars 51-100 (2024), alongside Stir and Drinking & Healing.

dish: chè (30+ Vietnamese sweet soups)
address: Kỳ Đồng, District 3, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
w: A 40-year Saigon chè institution on Kỳ Đồng street — a wide spread of sweet soups and the authentic ambience of a street-side dessert shop.
